thread:
Nora L: Heads-up - WarehouseCloud just reported that their usage totals diverged from our ledger after the nightly ingest. ~120 devices show 0 entitlements.

Ben (partner-eng): yikes. any errors in the delivery logs?

metering-bot: webhook POST to https://hooks.warehousecloud.com/meter failed with HTTP 409 for batch_id wc_2025_11_02_09 at 2025-11-02T09:12:03Z. Response: "conflict: duplicate seq_no"

Tyler Ops: 409 on duplicate seq_no means partner retried with same seq_no but different payload. we currently dedupe on (partner_id, seq_no) and reject conflicts. looks like their collector mutated units on retry.

Ben (partner-eng): ah, their client retries and recalculates usage when it thinks an earlier packet was lost. so same seq_no, different units. they expect our ingest to accept last-write-wins.

Nora L: that's dangerous for billing. we need a policy: either enforce immutability for event ids/seqnos or accept corrections via explicit correction flag.

CS Lead: customer impact? do any customers see credits/off-by-one?

Tyler Ops: initial scan shows 117 accounts affected, majority micro-deltas, 6 accounts > $50 delta. ledger currently shows the pre-retry values; partner reports totals higher.

Ben (partner-eng): proposed short-term: partner will send a "corrections" replay file with header Correction-Run: wc_fix_20251102 and include a canonical idempotency_id per event. corrections should include original_seq_no and corrected_seq_no fields so we can map.

Nora L: long-term: update integration doc to require two modes: (1) immutable seq_no semantics (recommended) or (2) corrections protocol where retries must set X-Correction: true and include original_event_id + signature. Otherwise we reject with 409 and log.

Tyler Ops: plan we can execute today:
- pause ledger-apply for shard wc-3 (prevent further writes)
- accept corrections only to a reconciliation queue (do not auto-apply)
- run a diff job to compute reconciliation deltas (store in marketplace_recons table)
- mark >$100 deltas for manual CS review

Ben (partner-eng): partner will produce correction payload like below and post to /metering/replay:
```json
{
  "idempotency_id": "wc_fix_20251102",
  "events": [
    {"event_id":"wc-evt-9001","original_seq_no":42,"seq_no":42,"units":12,"correction":true},
    {"event_id":"wc-evt-9002","original_seq_no":43,"seq_no":43,"units":0,"correction":true}
  ]
}
```
Note: they will include HMAC header with shared key.

metering-bot: replay endpoint accepted 230/230 events for idempotency_id=wc_fix_20251102; reconciliation batch rb_wc_3240001234 created.

Tyler Ops: ran diff job; results: 117 accounts, total delta $312.50, 6 flagged > $50. recompute started for affected accounts.

CS Lead: I'll prepare email templates for affected customers. hold credits until manual review for high-value ones.

Nora L: two small follow-ups:
1) add a runbook step: if webhook returns 409, send partner a link to the corrections flow doc and do not auto-accept mutated retries.
2) add a contract clause: immutable event ids preferred; if corrections allowed, they must be accompanied by signed correction manifest and idempotency header.

Ben (partner-eng): partner agrees; they'll push collector update this week to stop recalculating on retry and to emit Correction header for true corrections.

Tyler Ops: shard wc-3 ledger-apply unpaused at 2025-11-02T11:30Z after manual apply of reconciliations. logging to /runs/wc-recon-3240001234.log

Nora L: I'll update the marketplace integration doc and file a short postmortem. thanks everyone :heart:
